- Input has a vertical line of 8s at column 4 (rows 0-1), and two 2s at row 2, columns 0-1

1. Find the vertical line of 8s (or extend it to full height)
2. Find the horizontal line of 2s (extend it to full width)
3. Where they intersect, place 4
4. The 8s and 2s extend to fill their respective rows/columns completely
